lines.en: I drag my cables along the floor.

lines.zh: 我的两个头朝着不同方向。
lines.en: My two heads look different ways.

lines.zh: 我爬过地砖，线一路散着。
lines.en: I crawl over the tiles, wires trailing.
Only half of my joints still connect.
I haul myself forward on one hand.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地上滑来滑去。
lines.en: My feet slide back and forth.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，电线缠成一团。
lines.en: Where I pass, the cables tangle.

lines.zh: 我的下巴垂着，晃来晃去。
lines.en: My jaw hangs and sways.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到游戏机旁边。
lines.en: I creep beside the arcade cabinet.
I move forward while a head turns back.

lines.zh: 我的骨头露在外面，很凉。
lines.en: My endoskeleton shows, and it's cold.

lines.zh: 我爬得很慢，但一直在动。
lines.en: I crawl slowly but never stop.

lines.zh: 我卡在门框上，挣了一下。
lines.en: I jam in the doorway and wrench free.

lines.zh: 我的线勾到椅子腿，拖着走。
lines.en: A wire snags a chair leg and drags.
I sway as if about to fall apart.

lines.zh: 我在地板上留下一道划痕。
lines.en: I leave a scratch along the floor.

lines.zh: 我坐在角落里，电线绕成一圈。
lines.en: I sit in the corner, wires in a coil.
My second head is looking at me.

lines.zh: 我在拨弄自己的一根线。
lines.en: I fiddle with one of my wires.

lines.zh: 灯照在我露出的骨架上。
lines.en: The lamp lights my exposed frame.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有线在晃。
lines.en: I stay still; only the wires sway.
My head hangs; I can only tilt.

lines.zh: 有人把我拆开过，没装回去。
lines.en: Someone took me apart and didn't rebuild me.

lines.zh: 我听见游戏机在放音乐。
lines.en: I hear the arcade machine playing.
My fingers tap the floor.
I'm waiting for the day to end.

lines.zh: 我的一只眼睛转不动了。
lines.en: One of my eyes won't turn.
It's quiet here. It suits me.
I wind a wire around my wrist.
By day I can only sit.
Half my fur is gone.

lines.zh: 有只蜘蛛爬进我的骨架里。
lines.en: A spider crawls into my frame.

lines.zh: 你踩到线了，那是我的位子。
lines.en: You stepped on the cable, that is my spot.
Both my heads are on you.
Don't be scared; I'm just in pieces.
Could you reattach my hand?
I'm not like this at night.
Won't you sit with me?
My smile's crooked. Sorry.
Turn that torch off.
I've played this machine before.
I can't turn my neck.
Have you counted my heads?
Sitting, I'm shorter than you.
Another piece came off.

lines.zh: 几根电线从颈口垂下来，拍着地。
lines.en: A few wires dangle from my neck and tap the floor.
This head is dizzy.
I brace on the floor and barely sit up.
Something inside clanks.
You crushed one of my fingers.
I tip sideways and catch the wall.
My jaw has come off again.

lines.zh: 这一下让我短路了一瞬。
lines.en: That shorted me for a moment.
I'll need to put myself together again.
That wire is out of reach.
That battery; hand it over.

lines.zh: 这点电，让我眼睛亮了些。
lines.en: That spark brightened my eyes.
You set the toolbox down.
I could use some repair.
That screw is exactly what's missing.
I crawl slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 声音就在附近，我闻到了。
lines.en: The sound is nearby; I can sense it.
You crouch, and I can see you clearly.
I reach out without grabbing.

lines.zh: 那颗电池滚过来，我的手指抽动。
lines.en: The battery rolls over and my fingers twitch.
I tilt my head and look a long while.
That warmth feels good.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子又近了一点。
lines.en: I drag myself a little nearer.
Don't go; I haven't reached it.
I raise my hand a bit more.
You hit me and wires spill out.

lines.zh: 我的头掉下来，滚到脚边。
lines.en: One head drops and rolls to my foot.

lines.zh: 我往后一退，压到自己的线。
lines.en: I recoil onto my own cables.
Don't step; that's part of me.
We collide and I nearly come apart.

lines.zh: 白天我就站在展位上，不动。
lines.en: By day I stand on display, motionless.
My frame jabs you; it's hard.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，线还在你脚上。
lines.en: I turn aside, and a wire stays on your foot.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我少了一根手指。
lines.en: That cost me a finger.

lines.zh: 你退开时把我拖了一段。
lines.en: You pull me along as you step away.

lines.zh: 另一只也散着架，靠过来。
lines.en: Another broken one drags itself near.
Our wires have tangled together.

lines.zh: 它有三个头，我只有两个。
lines.en: It has three heads; I have two.
We sit side by side, unmoving.

lines.zh: 它把头滚给我，我接住了。
lines.en: It rolls a head to me and I catch it.
Our smiles are crooked the same way.

lines.zh: 我们一起听着游戏机的音乐。
lines.en: Together we listen to the arcade music.

lines.zh: 它身上的绒毛和我一样少。
lines.en: It has as little fur as I do.

lines.zh: 地上的线，分不出是谁的。
lines.en: On the floor, the wires are no one's.

lines.zh: 夜里，我们会一起站起来。
lines.en: At night we'll stand together.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗螺丝，塞进去。
lines.en: I pick up a screw and fit it in.
That wire is mine. Leave it.
I gather the fallen parts.
A coin on the floor; I take it.
I take it in my teeth and swallow slowly.
This can repair me.
I wind it around my wrist.
I bend, and it takes effort.

lines.zh: 它落到我骨架里，看不见了。
lines.en: It falls into my frame and disappears.
I'll keep it for later.
You've disturbed my wires.
I see you, from down here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把歪掉的头抬正。
lines.en: I slowly right my crooked head.
I have some strength by day too.
You're standing on me. It hurts.
I start gathering my wires.
Both my heads have locked on.
Don't back behind the arcade machine.
Still by day. Moving by night.
This time I can reach.
I crawl along the tiles.
Both my heads turn after you.
My cables drag along the floor.
I slip under the counter.

lines.zh: 你听见刮地的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear that scraping?
I'm slowly nearing your feet.
I change angle and jam.
I put a little of myself back together.
You stand out in the lamplight.
A little closer is enough.
My hand catches your shoelace.
I bite and my jaw falls off.
My frame knocks your leg.
Not much force behind that.

lines.zh: 我用线缠了一下你的脚踝。
lines.en: I loop a wire round your ankle.
You pull back, and wires scatter.

lines.zh: 我的头在你旁边滚过去。
lines.en: One of my heads rolls past you.
You knock my hand aside.
I lunge and collapse again.
I'm not apart yet. Don't go.

lines.zh: 游戏机旁边多了一堆零件。
lines.en: A heap of parts appears by the arcade.
I poke a head out from under the counter.
Someone has pushed me into the corner.
A ring of cables lies on the floor.

lines.zh: 这屋里多了一个坐着的东西。
lines.en: Something new sits in the room.

lines.zh: 我的第二个头先转过来。
lines.en: My second head turns first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地把自己拼起来。
lines.en: I slowly put myself together.
The arcade lights are on, and so am I.
I sit up out of the debris.

lines.zh: 我的骨架在地上响了一下。
lines.en: My frame clanks on the floor.
Fire catches and my wires smoke.
I fall and scatter into pieces.
Water's in my frame; I can't move.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的零件吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters my parts.

lines.zh: 一枚东西卡在我的骨架里。
lines.en: Something lodges in my frame.

lines.zh: 法术让我的线全僵住了。
lines.en: That spell stiffens all my wires.
Out of power; I'm fading.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的灯全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all my lights flare.

lines.zh: 虚空把我的零件一个个收走。
lines.en: The void takes my parts one by one.
